predictionQuestions.question: If you deposit 1,000 dollars at 5% interest, will compounding give you more than 150 dollars after three years?

causalChain.condition: A deposit earns interest and the interest is kept in the account
causalChain.action: Next period's interest is computed on the new, larger total balance
causalChain.mechanism: The principal grows exponentially through multiplication by (1 + r) each period
causalChain.result: Interest starts earning interest on itself
causalChain.consequence: The growth curve becomes steeper every year compared to simple linear interest
